method: Visual inspection of five rendered contact sheets covering all fourteen changed pages and all four figure pages; page numbers are PDF positions, not printed folios.
findings: No clipped text, overlapping table/text, or figure/legend collision observed in the inspected renderings. The added reference has a hanging indent and readable URL wrapping. Table A.1 fits its page. Page 146 retains the appendix-ending whitespace before Appendix B.
limits: A bounded rendered-PDF inspection, not a guarantee about every Word version or printer. Unchanged pages inherit the prior documented layout review; no new visual review of all 150 pages is claimed.
